blockers.title: Every db.execute is now a one-statement write transaction, so SQLite refuses the erase's VACUUM and the erase swallows the error. Names of erased students stay in the database file. Fixed by 56bd22c, which landed during this review.
blockers.evidence: src/persistence/writeGuard.ts:87-90 routes execute through the guarded writeTransaction. PowerSync opens that with BEGIN IMMEDIATE (node_modules/@powersync/web/node_modules/@powersync/common/lib/db/DBAdapter.js:110). src/persistence/courses.ts:99 then runs db.execute("VACUUM") inside it, and the catch at :100 hides the refusal. Measured in the dev app, through the UI: create a course, add three students whose first names carry a synthetic marker, then Impostazioni > Elimina il corso > Elimina tutto. I scanned IndexedDB 'cvc-helper.db/blocks' for the marker. On 57430a5 (Chromium Pixel 7 and WebKit iPhone 13): blocksWithMarker 1 before the erase and still 1 after it. db.execute('VACUUM') returns 'cannot VACUUM from within a transaction'. db.writeLock(tx => tx.execute('VACUUM')), the path execute used before this round, returns ok and the marker is gone (0). On 0aa6699, served from a copy of that tree: the UI erase leaves 0 blocks with the marker, and db.execute('VACUUM') returns ok. No test covered this: courses.test.ts mocks execute. 56bd22c ('the erase compacts again under the write guard', DI-R2-1) moves VACUUM under writeLock. I re-ran the same probe on 56bd22c: 0 blocks with the marker after the UI erase, on Chromium and WebKit (2 passed, code=0).
blockers.reproduction: Throwaway spec in my scratchpad's r2/erase.r2.ts (run from test-results/r2-segugio with its own config on a dev server): create a course, add 3 students through the form, erase through Impostazioni, then read every value of IndexedDB cvc-helper.db/blocks and count the blocks that contain the marker bytes. Expected 0 after the erase; observed 1 on 57430a5 and 0 on 0aa6699 and on 56bd22c.
blockers.specRef: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §2 ('erases the current course and everything recorded in it from the device'); src/persistence/courses.ts:69-72 ('nothing about the previous week's students (minors included) stays behind on the device'); AGENTS.md §17 privacy

blockers.title: UG2-UX-3 is fixed only at normal text size on screens of 360x640 and larger. On short screens or with larger text, the crew page's quick-access rail is still drawn over the bar where the crew page opens. At 150% text it covers both of the offer's buttons, so a tap on Aggiorna lands on 'Volontari'.
blockers.evidence: The crew column is h-[calc(100dvh-7rem-var(--update-banner-height))] but keeps min-h-[28rem] (src/features/crews/CrewManagement.tsx:2639). The rail is a flex item with z-20 (:3593), above the bar's z-10 (src/components/UpdateAvailableBanner.tsx:81). When 28rem wins, the rail sits below the bar's top and is painted over it, and it also passes over the bar on every scroll. Offer state, production builds 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 on one origin, offer raised by a return to the foreground, crew page at scrollY 0, elementFromPoint at the button centres. 390x844 at 150% text: banner 592-731, rail 572-690. Più tardi and Aggiorna both hit 'Accesso rapido equipaggi', and the text hits 'Volontari' (Chromium and WebKit). 430x820 (the rulebook's first design profile) at 150%: banner 568-707, rail 597-690. Più tardi hits 'Collocati 0/10' and Aggiorna hits 'Volontari'. At 320x568, 390x664 at 115%, 360x780 at 130% and 412x760 at 130%, the rail covers the banner text (58, 58, 36 and 56 px of overlap); the button centres are still reachable. Read-only bar, dev server, Chromium and WebKit identical: at 430x820 at 150%, 93 px of overlap and 'Cerca aggiornamento' hits the rail (screenshot: only 'iornamento' shows). At 390x844 at 150%, 118 px. Clear at normal text from 360x640 up, which is the case scripts/check-update-journey.mjs measures (viewport 390x844 only, :325). So check:update passes while the defect remains. The rulebook requires text at 200% (R05), and 01 §2 now promises that the rail 'rises above' the bar.

importantFindings.title: The update note now shows on whatever screen opens, and after an update applied from the crew page it pushes the quick-access rail behind the bottom navigation
importantFindings.evidence: This round moved the note from Home to every screen (src/App.tsx:706, state at :836). The crew page's fixed-height column (CrewManagement.tsx:2639) does not account for it, so the column, and the rail at its bottom, move about 70 px down. The bottom navigation then paints over the rail, since both are z-20 and the navigation comes later in the DOM. Production builds 0.3.0 and 0.3.1: on the crew page, tap Aggiorna on the offer. The app reloads onto Equipaggi showing 'CVC Helper è aggiornata alla versione 0.3.1.' (note 8-70). Before the update: rail 686-744, navigation 769-844, and 'A terra' and 'Volontari' reachable. After it: rail 756-814 against the navigation at 769-844, with both buttons' centres hitting the navigation's icons. Same at 412x839 (rail 751-809, navigation 764-839), 412x760, 390x664 and 360x640, on Chromium and WebKit. The rail stays hidden until the note is closed or the page is scrolled (94 px). On 0aa6699 the note was shown only on Home. Updating from the crew page is the routine case: the offer arrives when the phone comes back to the foreground, and the reload keeps the view (FU-Q3).
importantFindings.reproduction: My scratchpad's r2/note-tail.mjs (production two-build journey): course, student, Crea equipaggi, background, deploy N+1, foreground, tap 'Aggiorna CVC Helper alla nuova versione' on the crew page. After the reload, measure the rail, the navigation and elementFromPoint at the rail's buttons. Screenshot r2/note-crew-chromium.png: the rail is hidden behind Avarie / Home / Equipaggi.
importantFindings.specRef: docs/design/06_DESIGN_RULEBOOK.md R12; docs/design/07_PAGE_CHANGELOG.md P14 (the rail stays above the bottom navigation); 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §2 (the note 'once, on its first screen')

qolFindings.title: With read-only data and no course, the bar covers the end of course creation: the lower part of 'Crea corso' and the save-failed alert under it
qolFindings.evidence: CourseCreation's main keeps pb-8 (src/App.tsx:306) and does not add --update-banner-height. The bar sits at bottom 0 there, because there is no navigation. At 320x568, scrolled to the end: 'Crea corso' 419-467 against the bar at 455-568. Tapping it shows 'Il corso non è stato salvato. Riprova.' below the button, under the bar. This replaces round 1's RH-Q5. The state is rare, since a newer app must have erased the course.

qolFindings.title: The read-only bar keeps an old search result after the update becomes ready, for example 'Nessuna versione più recente disponibile ora.' next to 'Aggiorna'
qolFindings.evidence: src/components/UpdateAvailableBanner.tsx:95 renders CHECK_RESULT[check] whenever readOnly && check. The check state is never cleared when `visible` turns true (:112 swaps in Aggiorna). So 'none' or 'downloading' from an earlier 'Cerca aggiornamento' stays beside the Aggiorna button once the hourly check or the return to the foreground brings the version.
qolFindings.reproduction: Code reading; not run in a browser, because a read-only course plus a waiting worker needs two builds that also write newer data.

qolFindings.title: When the data turns read-only during an edit, the first Back right after typing is held, and only a second Back leaves
qolFindings.evidence: exitForm checks dataIsReadOnly() before saving (src/features/students/StudentManagement.tsx:741). The data is not yet known to be read-only until the save is refused, so the first Back tries the save, fails and stays. Measured: stillOnFormAfterFirstBack 1, stillOnFormAfterSecondBack 0 on Chromium and WebKit; WebKit also shows 'Modifiche non salvate. Il testo resta qui. Riprova'. Not a trap: the second Back leaves.
qolFindings.reproduction: My scratchpad's r2/trap.r2.ts, second test: new course and student > Modifica allievo > raiseMinimumWriterUnderOpenApp > type in Nota del corso > tap 'Indietro da Modifica allievo' at once.
qolFindings.specRef: 01_PRODUCT_SPEC.md §2 ('no screen holds the user waiting for a save')
